headline: Flat on a like-for-like basis as broadband investment weighs
summary_short: Revenue fell 6.1% y/y to $29.3B but was up 0.5% pro forma for the Versant spin-off and Sky Germany sale; adjusted EPS was $1.07, down 4.0%.
summary_long: Connectivity & Platforms revenue fell 2.7% and adjusted EBITDA 4.4%, reflecting go-to-market investment. Peacock posted $261M of EBITDA on $1.8B of revenue with 48 million paid subscribers. Domestic wireless added 368,000 lines. Free cash flow was $4.2B and dividends paid were $1.2B. Comcast suspended its share repurchase program from Q3 through the planned separation of NBCUniversal and Sky.
confidence_notes: Headline revenue and EBITDA declines are mostly separation effects; pro forma revenue grew 0.5% and pro forma adjusted EBITDA 0.8%. Adjusted EPS and adjusted EBITDA are non-GAAP. Shard EPS (basic 0.97) matches diluted 0.97 in the release.

drivers.explanation: Reported decline reflects the Versant separation and Sky Germany sale; pro forma revenue was consistent with the prior year at plus 0.5 percent.
Connectivity & Platforms EBITDA fell on a decline in Residential, which management attributes to investment in its go-to-market strategy, partly offset by Business Services growth.
Co-CEOs say near-term results reflect investments to navigate a dynamic environment, while separation of NBCUniversal and Sky remains on track.
